title: Identification of Four Novel Prognostic Biomarkers and Construction of Two Nomograms in Adrenocortical Carcinoma: A Multi-Omics Data Study via Bioinformatics and Machine Learning Methods.
summary: The study uses seven independent datasets, differential-expression/network analyses and LDA/KNN/SVM to prioritize four adrenocortical-carcinoma prognostic genes (ASPM, BIRC5, CCNB2, CDK1), with survival and mutation analyses. This supports an exploratory retrospective biomarker result, not prospective clinical utility. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
